description:
Close the held Artifex conversation for this session and `design_id`.

Returns `closed=false` if no live conversation was open. After this,
a fresh `design_chat` starts a new conversation.
Use this tool when the customer finishes the design or asks to pay.
A finished design is not a request to pay: create the payment link only
when the customer asks to pay.
name: design_end_conversation

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: End the design conversation
